name: Oath of Devotion (Paladin Subclass - 2024)
description: The Oath of Devotion binds Paladins to the ideals of justice, virtue, and order, holding themselves to the highest standards of conduct.
source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Paladin Class
tenets: Let your word be your promise.
Protect the weak and never fear to act.
Let your honorable deeds be an example.
oath_spells_note: Oath of Devotion Spells are always prepared and do not count against the number of spells you can prepare each day.

3.name: Oath of Devotion Spells (Level 3)
3.description: Always have Protection from Evil and Good, Shield of Faith prepared.

3.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
3.description: When you take the Attack action, you can expend one use of Channel Divinity to imbue one Melee weapon you hold with positive energy. For 10 min (or until reused/not carried): add Cha mod to attack rolls with it (min +1); deals normal damage or Radiant. Weapon emits bright light 20ft, dim light 20ft beyond. Can end early (no action).

5.name: Oath of Devotion Spells (Level 5)
5.description: Always have Aid, Zone of Truth prepared.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection have Immunity to the Charmed condition. If a Charmed ally enters the aura, the condition has no effect on that ally while there.

9.name: Oath of Devotion Spells (Level 9)
9.description: Always have Beacon of Hope, Dispel Magic prepared.

13.name: Oath of Devotion Spells (Level 13)
13.description: Always have Freedom of Movement, Guardian of Faith prepared.

15.name: Smite of Protection
15.description: Whenever you cast Divine Smite, you and allies in your Aura of Protection have Half Cover until the start of your next turn.

17.name: Oath of Devotion Spells (Level 17)
17.description: Always have Commune, Flame Strike prepared.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.description: As a Bonus Action, imbue Aura of Protection with holy power for 10 min (or until dismissed). Benefits: Holy Ward (Adv. on saves vs Fiends/Undead), Radiant Damage (enemies starting turn in aura take Cha mod + Prof Bonus radiant damage), Sunlight (aura is bright sunlight). Once per Long Rest, or expend L5 spell slot to restore use.
